# QuickReference

If you want to paste this into a text editor that can't handle
the fancy Unicode section headers, try using
[QuickReferenceNoUnicode](QuickReferenceNoUnicode) instead.

```c
// MojoELF API Quick Reference
//
// https://github.com/icculus/mojoelf
//
// The latest version of this document can be found at https://wiki.icculus.org/MojoELF/QuickReference
// Based on MojoELF version 0.0.9
//
// This can be useful in an IDE with search and syntax highlighting.
//
// Original idea for this document came from Dan Bechard (thanks!)
// ASCII art generated by: https://patorjk.com/software/taag/#p=display&f=ANSI%20Shadow (with modified 'S' for readability)


// ███╗   ███╗  ██████╗       ██╗  ██████╗  ███████╗ ██╗      ███████╗
// ████╗ ████║ ██╔═══██╗      ██║ ██╔═══██╗ ██╔════╝ ██║      ██╔════╝
// ██╔████╔██║ ██║   ██║      ██║ ██║   ██║ █████╗   ██║      █████╗
// ██║╚██╔╝██║ ██║   ██║ ██   ██║ ██║   ██║ ██╔══╝   ██║      ██╔══╝
// ██║ ╚═╝ ██║ ╚██████╔╝ ╚█████╔╝ ╚██████╔╝ ███████╗ ███████╗ ██║
// ╚═╝     ╚═╝  ╚═════╝   ╚════╝   ╚═════╝  ╚══════╝ ╚══════╝ ╚═╝

#define MOJOELF_DECL                                                                         // A macro to tag a symbol as a public API.
#define MOJOELF_CALL                                                                         // The calling conventions for MojoELF entry points.
#define MOJOELF_MAJOR_VERSION                                                                // The current major version of MojoELF headers.
#define MOJOELF_MINOR_VERSION                                                                // The current minor version of the MojoELF headers.
#define MOJOELF_MICRO_VERSION                                                                // The current micro (or patchlevel) version of the MojoELF headers.
void * MOJOELF_dlopen_mem(const void *buf, const long buflen, const MOJOELF_Callbacks *cb);  // Dynamically load an ELF binary from memory.
void * MOJOELF_dlopen_file(const char *fname, const MOJOELF_Callbacks *cb);                  // Dynamically load an ELF binary from a path on the filesystem.
void * MOJOELF_dlsym(void *lib, const char *sym);                                            // Lookup a symbol in an ELF binary.
void MOJOELF_dlclose(void *lib);                                                             // Dispose of a previously-loaded ELF binary.
const char * MOJOELF_dlerror(void);                                                          // Obtain a human-readable error message for MojoELF problems.
const void * MOJOELF_getentry(void *lib);                                                    // Obtain an ELF binary's official entry point.
void MOJOELF_getmmaprange(void *lib, void **addr, unsigned long *len);                       // Determine the full address space of a loaded ELF binary.
```
